ko: [Title] MAIN_LOG_107_1
[Div] Part.02
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]니어, 이런 신분을 나타내는 액세서리는 너희 집에도 많지 않아?
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]……소위 혈통과 명예라는 건 지배계급의 일시적인 찬란일 뿐이다. 그들에게 주어진 영광 또한 지워지기 쉬워. 마치 이 브로치처럼.
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=1.5)]황금은 단지 신분을 과시하는 장식품에 지나지 않아. 실전에서는 그래도 오리지늄 회로에 의지할 수밖에 없어. 만약 가해지는 힘이 회로가 막을 수 있는 범주를 초과한다면……
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=1.5)]이렇게……
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)](공격 소리) 퍽~
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]막아낼 수 없지.
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]잠깐 휴식하자. 오리지늄 회로도 충전하는 데 시간이 걸리니까.
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]어휴, 너무 거친 거 아니야? 하마터면 못 받아낼 뻔했잖아.
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]휴식 시간이야? 그럼 브로치 좀 잠깐 봐도 될까? 음……
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]위쪽 면에 있는 결정체는 확실히 귀중하네. 충분히 연구할 가치가 있어.
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]이 정도 순도의 경화 오리지늄 결정은 좀처럼 보기 드문데. 상당한 자금과 강력한 기술 지원이 없으면 채굴조차도 힘들어.
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]……
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]여긴 좀 어두워서 잘 안 보이네. 아쉽다.
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]내 작업실에 가서 제대로 봤으면 좋겠는데……
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]이 브로치를 내가…… 살 수 있으면 얼마나 좋을까.
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]……
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]……너희들 왜 말이 없어?
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=1)]끼어들 틈도 없잖아.
en: [Title] MAIN_LOG_107_1
[Div] Part.02
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]Nearl, I'm sure you have status jewelry like this in your family, don't you?
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]...Bloodlines and reputation are but temporary splendors of the ruling class. The glory they accord them is so easily wiped away. Just like this brooch.

[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=1.5)]The gold is merely a manifestation of ornamental nature. What it truly relies on in battle are these Originium circuits. If the pressure exerted exceeds what the circuit can ward...
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=1.5)]Then as simply as that...
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)](Attacking sound)
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]The warding falters.
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]Let's take a break, and give the circuit the time it needs to recharge.
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]My, my, you were at my throat for a moment there. I almost couldn't block you.
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]Break time? Then can I take a look at the brooch? Hmm...
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]The Originium crystals on top are definitely precious. Very valuable for research.
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]Solid Originium crystals of this purity aren't common. Nor are they easily extracted, without just as much funding and tech.
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)](Sounds of breathing)
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]There's not enough light here. Shame. I can't quite make them out clearly.
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]I'd love to take it to my workbench, and find the time to give them a decent look...
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]What a brooch... If only I could just buy it for myself.
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)](Sounds of breathing)
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]...Why are you two so quiet?
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=1)]Can't get a word in edgeways.
ja: [Title] MAIN_LOG_107_1
[Div] Part.02
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]ところでニアール、こういう身分を表すアクセサリーは、君の家にもあるんじゃないか？
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]……血統と名誉は統治階級の一時的な繁栄の象徴にすぎず、そんな者たちに付与された栄光は壊れやすい。このブローチのようにな。
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=1.5)]黄金は身分を示す装飾でしかない。実戦の中で本当に頼れるのはこれらの源石回路の方だ。もし加えられた圧力が源石回路の耐久値を超えた場合は――
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=1.5)]こうなるだけだ。
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]（攻撃の音）
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]防ぎきれない。
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]少し休もう。源石回路のチャージには時間が必要だ。
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]っはは、随分容赦ないね。受け止めきれないところだったよ。
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]休憩？　なら今のうちにブローチを見せてもらってもいいかしら？　ありがとう。
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]この結晶は確かに貴重よね……とても研究価値があるわ。
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]こんな純度の高い高安定性源石結晶はかなり珍しいわ。相当な資金と技術力がないと採掘できないわよ。
[Dialog(head="char_148_nearl", delay=0.5)]……
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]ここじゃちょっと暗すぎて、よく見えないわね。
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]作業台でじっくり見てみたいわ……
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]このブローチ……買い取れたら一番いいんだけど。
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=0.5)]……
[Dialog(head="char_183_skgoat", delay=0.5)]……どうして黙ってるの？
[Dialog(head="char_426_billro", delay=1)]口を挟む隙がなかったから。
